plan.title: The Case of Missing Omnioculars
plan.story: Sherlock Holmes is investigating a rash of stolen omnioculars. With every witness watching the Snitch, the thief has picked an excellent moment.
plan.background: Dense, colourful pixel art viewed from a wide elevated angle inside an enormous floodlit stadium at night. A grassy oval pitch lies far below towering tiers of spectators, with three tall golden goal hoops at either end. The final seconds feel frantic: a tiny golden winged speck flashes over the pitch, while scattered anonymous broom-riding athletes in red or green streak elsewhere through the air. The stands overflow with generic spectators wearing green shamrock hats or red scarves, waving flags, peering through elaborate brass binoculars, spilling drinks, arguing over betting slips and scrambling after windblown programmes. Include a dropped binocular case, a suspiciously bulging souvenir bag, dancing green lights and a snack seller whose tray is tipping. Leave small pockets among the spectators and an open patch of air near the golden speck for separately placed sprites. Background contains only anonymous extras, with none of the featured characters.

guest.name: Sherlock Holmes
guest.look: A tall, lean man around forty with a pale angular face, a long sharp nose and dark hair beneath a brown checked deerstalker cap. He wears a matching tweed cape coat over a tan waistcoat and dark trousers, holding one magnifying glass while bending slightly forward with narrowed, intensely curious eyes.
guest.line: The Snitch is elusive. Our pickpocket is merely overconfident.

residents.name: Harry Potter
residents.look: A slim teenage boy with messy black hair, green eyes behind round black glasses and a small lightning-shaped forehead scar. He wears a navy zip-up jacket over a grey shirt and blue jeans, craning upward with an excited, open-mouthed expression.
residents.line: Not me! You're missing the match.

residents.name: Ron Weasley
residents.look: A lanky teenage boy with shaggy ginger hair, a long nose and a heavily freckled face. He wears a maroon knitted jumper and tan trousers, leaning forward with wide eyes and both empty hands raised in excitement.
residents.line: Wrong bloke! I'm trying to watch!

residents.name: Hermione Granger
residents.look: A teenage girl with a thoughtful face and thick, bushy brown hair falling past her shoulders. She wears a dusty pink zip-up hoodie and blue jeans, standing with folded arms and one eyebrow raised.
quips: The score still matters, you know.
residents.line: No. Perhaps try observing more carefully.

residents.name: Viktor Krum
residents.look: A muscular late-teen boy with very short dark hair, thick eyebrows, a prominent hooked nose and a fiercely concentrated expression. He wears a red athletic tunic with black trim, red trousers, leather gloves and black boots, crouched low over one wooden broom with one empty hand reaching forward.
residents.line: Not now. I am catching something.
